verdict.rationale: Formant's docs mention a built-in AI assistant that can help build analytics dashboards. Its product pages describe asking the fleet questions in plain language and getting ML-driven task recommendations, with people approving what happens next. That is a real in-product assistant, but the only evidenced task it handles is dashboard building, and fleet actions are framed as recommendations rather than tasks the assistant carries out. missing for 10: documented assistant capabilities and scope, evidence of the assistant executing delegated tasks end-to-end (e.g., sending commands or running workflows), in-depth docs beyond one-line mentions, independent or hands-on corroboration
